summary.zh: 安装前需在手机端开启经典 TCP ADB（Stellar/Shizuku TCP 或 adb tcpip）；插件自动查找端口并保持连接。只读诊断可直接执行，改动设备或可能丢数据的命令会在代码层拦截，其余操作需先确认。
summary.en: Requires classic TCP ADB enabled on the phone (Stellar/Shizuku TCP or adb tcpip) before installing. Finds the ADB port and keeps it connected. Read-only diagnostics run directly; mutating or destructive commands are blocked in code, and other operations require confirmation.
